suggestedRule.cause:zsh-glob-path: zsh: an unmatched glob aborts the command even with 2>/dev/null. List with find or fd, or quote the pattern.
suggestedRule.cause:pkill-self-kill: pkill -f PAT matches the harness shell, whose command line holds the whole call, and kills it (exit 144). Kill by name (pkill -x NAME) or by a saved PID (kill "$(cat srv.pid)"). A bracketed '[p]attern' helps only when no other part of the call repeats the plain text: pkill -f '[b]un run dev'; bun run dev & still dies.
suggestedRule.cause:sleep-blocked: Don't sleep N && cmd: wait with an until-loop (until grep -q DONE f; do sleep 2; done), Monitor, or run_in_background.
suggestedRule.cause:zsh-equals-abort: quote the separator: echo "===" — zsh expands a bare === to a command name, exits 1, and never runs the rest of the line
suggestedRule.cause:output-too-large: Never print a full-branch git diff: run git diff --stat first, then diff one file at a time.
suggestedRule.cause:scratch-module-resolution: Run scratch scripts that import project packages from inside the project (bun -e, or a file under the repo), not from /tmp: modules resolve from the script's own directory.
